mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia) which are worsened by prednisolone's mineralocorticoid effects and increased urinary electrolyte loss.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, potassium) closely during concurrent use; consider electrolyte supplementation and dose adjustment of prednisolone if possible.
